hypotheses.justification: Derive htotal from x instead. Let z be its physicalProfile and H := physicalProfile_feasible r c x. The lemma pattern_small_totals applied to H.pattern equates the small-row and small-column totals. The total rowLargeCount equals the total columnLargeCount by their definitions and Finset.sum_comm. Expanding H.totals therefore gives equal original margin totals after cancellation: H.residuals ensures all natural subtractions are untruncated, so this calculation can be performed in ℤ. Supply this derived equality to unitNext_encoded and retain the existing proof. The argument includes empty index types and zero margins; if PaperStates is empty, the binder x already makes the theorem vacuous.
